reviews.text:
Thank you, Dr. Riehle, for your expertise and fabulous conexion with animals, our beloved pets; and all his staff, they live the pets as well. Dr. Riehle has taken care of Coda for five years. All that is required for travels overseas, plus checkups, and most importantly, being available when an urgent visit is necessary.

We thank Heights Animal Hospital, Dr Riehle, and staff. Coda loves you all, too!!
☮️❤️😊

RUDE! I called to inquire about a USDA health certificate and screwworm examination/certificate so I can travel to Mexico with my senior dog. Before I could even finish explaining what I needed, the man who answered immediately cut me off and said they “do not do any paperwork for Mexico,” followed by, “We don’t have anything to do with them. They don’t give us anything.”

First of all, who is “they”? The Mexicans? I genuinely don’t even know what he meant by that, but the attitude was completely unnecessary.

I was actually about to explain that this hospital is listed on the USDA APHIS website as having an accredited veterinarian, which is exactly why I called. But I barely had a chance to finish my sentence before being dismissed so rudely.

I understand if the hospital doesn’t provide this service. That’s completely fine. What is NOT fine is the way I was spoken to. Whoever answered the phone needs better training in basic customer service and should at least allow people to finish their sentences before cutting them off and speaking to them like they’re an inconvenience.

Kindness is free, my guy. You had absolutely no reason to speak to me that way.

And if the hospital no longer provides these services or cannot complete the required documentation, then perhaps they should clarify that with USDA/APHIS so pet owners aren’t calling based on information that leads them to believe an accredited veterinarian is available there.

That old man that’s like 80 years old in the back gave my dog an overdose of meds. He was a five year-old corgi named grumpy. I lost my dog because he wanted $900…… he needs to retire and give up the veterinarian  profession because of him he gave my dog an overdose his heart stopped. I gave my dog the medicine or medicines that he told me to give him. I found my dog dead a few hours later all my dog had was a bite on the back of his back from play fighting with his sibling. Be very careful with that elderly man

The vet tech he is very nice and great with animals
Front desk not so much vet is an older gentleman he seems annoyed grumpy
No boarding any longer they said because closed 2 days they used to and they were closed 2 days
SMH 🤦‍♀️ three stars for vet tech
Excellent professionals; they treated my pets with special care. The doctor is very experienced, which makes him very accurate in his diagnoses.

I wanted to take my adopted cat Stewy to this place but before doing so I went in to have a look at the place and they are never open. I went 3 different times during the weekdays. They don't answer their phone either.

The woman at reception was incredibly unfriendly, unlike the gentleman who was very polite and helpful! The woman was rude! I politely asked the gentleman at reception if I would be a little longer since I had already been there for an hour. He kindly answered and explained, but the woman next to him rudely told me, "I arranged your appointment, but I told you that you have to wait. Everyone wants to come, but no one wants to wait!" I replied that I was just asking!
I have been going to this vet for 4 years! They are the best. They’re affordable and all the workers are so kind. They really help the neighborhood too

I arrived 5 minutes before my scheduled appointment, but I was still waiting after an hour and a half. I noticed several people who arrived after me being called in first. When I asked the reception how much longer it would be, they dismissively told me they were busy and that I should understand. No apology at all.

If they knew they were running behind, they should have informed me at check-in. It felt like they have no respect for the patients' time. To make matters worse, they told me there were still three people ahead of me, even though I saw later arrivals go in before me. They clearly have zero control over their scheduling. I understand that emergencies happen, but acting like it’s okay to keep people waiting indefinitely with such an arrogant attitude is unacceptable.
Excellent service. All the staff were very attentive and friendly. They took the time to explain the entire process to me calmly and clearly. Very grateful. 100% recommended.

What  a GREAT Dr and staff. My Beba is alive because of the professionalism of this hospital. I would 100% recommend you to go if your pet is in a delicate situation. Thank you Dr Riehle and Staff I will always be so thankful

Great service, quick and professional! My little chihuahua is super wiggly but they did a great job with the shots, microchip, and nail trim. It wasn't busy so that was a plus. Prices were alot cheaper than other places I called! Very happy with the experience here.
They attended to me very quickly, they were very kind to my dogs, and the doctor was very accurate with what he prescribed for my dogs. Thank you so much!

Found this clinic near the airport. My dog became visibly sick as we traveled. Called and asked for an appointment, they didn’t have one, but then asked what was happening. Once I explained that she had thrown up and had blood in her stool, they said come in and wait.
This place is amazing and really cares for the animals. You can tell by their bedside manner. Totally reasonable in pricing too.

I took my cat here recenly. I've been here before already and decided to come back again. Everyone is so kind, from the front desk, vet techs and the veterinarian. Thank you for letting me walk in without an appointment, during a stressful time. The price is reasonable. Would definitely recommend them. I appreciate your help. Thank you for your service.

Originally gave them 5 stars but the front desk staff treated my mom like dirt. When it came to a payment my mother was looking for her card to pay for her cat’s fecal testing. Staff told her if you don’t have the money we will just throw away the sample. I was happy I was not with her but she was so upset they said such a thing. I called to explain what happened and front desk told me well we thought she didn’t have the money what’s the big deal? We have now switched vets for both our animals. The vet’s assistant is awesome though! It’s just not worth it to be treated like garbage.

My cat, Lucky, had seizures a month ago. Since it was 1 am, I rushed her to the emergency clinic. Once she was back home, I scheduled an appointment with Dr. Riehle. He thoroughly explained everything to me, including the treatment plan. He also helped me relax and manage my stress levels because seizures can be quite frightening. I’ve been coming here for years, and the staff is always incredibly friendly and caring. Thank you so much! 🩷

The clinic is very clean, and all the staff are friendly and kind. They pay great attention to pets and treat them with genuine care. The veterinarian was very professional and provided excellent treatment. I felt very comfortable and confident bringing my pet here. Highly recommended.

Great place
The vet very kind
He responded all my Questions
About my pet
Very busy
Great place for my furry friend. Clean and reasonable rates in the neighborhood of Jackson Heights, Queens.

The best veterinary clinic we could ever ask for. They were the only ones who truly helped us save our dog Fergie. Throughout this year, they have been incredibly patient, supportive, and kind. We are deeply grateful to Dr. Richle, Paola, Gabriel, Frank, Joselin, and Germán for all the love and understanding you gave to Fergie and to us. Your compassion and dedication will always stay in our hearts. Thank you for everything, we will always recommend you with love and appreciation.

Best Vet ever!!
Everyone here is SO kind, so knowledgeable, so caring.
The doctor has a 6th sense with the pets. He can very well pinpoint the issue with the dog, and he will always give recommendations on treatment or test, without putting any pressure to get it done.
Every time I come here I have this sense of comfort. I know my dog is at the best hands. Absolutely every single person at this clinic is a gem.
Saved my babies life didn’t know he had heart disease
Great vet for all your pet needs. People are friendly and they try to go with an economical approach before jumping to last resort.
Can anyone tell me if they have Facebook or Instagram?
Amazing experience every time. The staff is incredibly kind and caring, and the doctor is knowledgeable and truly passionate about animals. I always feel my pet is in the best hands here.

As a first time client I can wholeheartedly say the staff was incredibly welcoming and friendly. I was absolutely nervous about bringing my 13 year old stray to the vet for the first time since I got him at 5 months who is extremely skittish around strangers. However the staff was incredibly professional and so gentle they made our first time experience very positive and reassuring. I was expecting my cat to retreat and hide when I got home after being handled by strangers but he was back to his normal self almost immediately. He has gone through trauma in the past and he was perfectly fine after his first vet visit since he was 5 months old. I highly recommend this location if you're looking for one, 10/10 experience. thank you all so much.
Very good treatment, excellent people, a very nice place, my first time visiting it with our cat and it was excellent, highly recommended

It’s so hard to find a trustworthy, affordable vet in the neighborhood. Well look no further! They let me come in on a busy Saturday morning even without an appointment. We had to wait a while but somehow they squeezed us in despite having many patients. Rather than recommending lots of expensive tests, the Doc prescribed antibiotics to see if that would resolve my cat’s fever and low appetite. Voila, it worked!

I really appreciated their bedside manner, skillful handling of my nervous cat, and the friendly front desk staff, too. 🐈‍⬛💛
Excellent service. God bless all the staff who do the work every day.

This is the best place to get health certificates. They were all kind but  Carol was amazing. She was the most helpful, knowledgeable and courteous, really went out of her way to help!
Highly recommend this hospital.
Exceptional service and kindness! The vet and staff are top-notch. Highly recommend!
I live in Brooklyn and I go there just for the quality of service they have ❤️ my cat is always well taken care

We always come here for when our pets need something regarding to their health. The staff is always nice and we are treated with respect. They have also been there twice already when two of our prior dogs passed over to through the rainbow bridge, we received nothing but empathy, and they gave us time to the decide which cremation options we wanted. Lastly, Our dogs require special diet and so we can get the Royal Canine UC here for much less than major pet stores and websites.
Great place only vet my dog is ok with
I took 2 of my cats there. Both times were great, and everyone was so nice. They are honest and fairly priced. They listen to you and do not try to push things on the pet that they do not need.

Few years back our sweet bunny had small tumors all over her body, they were kind enough to take her in even though she was consider an exotic animal they were welcoming and did not charge me a different fee to see her, unfortunately it was too late and cancer had done it damage, given her age of 13 years we had to put her to sleep, they were super supportive compassionate; they let us held her until she went to sleep, this was a very positive experience for my family and best last moments for my baby to just go in our company.
Later they mailed me a post card of the rainbow with her name on it, I thought this was such a sweet detail that will make me come back here time for my other animals, this vet really cares about animals and their owners.
It’s a lovely place and it’s very affordable. Highly recommended.

I brought my dog here for the first time for a post ear infection treatment follow-up (previously she was treated elsewhere). I had a very pleasant experience. Dr. Riehl was extremely helpful, kind, and patient, despite how I inundated him with several questions that was not related to the ear infection since I am a first time dog mom (e.g. my dog’s itchy paws, how frequently I should bathe her, how often I should brush her teeth and more). Allegedly, his front desk staff informed me that he has been practicing over 50 years! His staff was quite friendly with my dog too, which I appreciated.

The only con is I did wait 1hr to see the vet, however it was understandable because there were other animals that needed to be urgently seen (e.g. a dog had active seizures).
Unbelievable veterinarian and extremely competent staff .. been going there for 36 years !

I'm heartbroken now! I wish I never had gone to this place 💔On friday I took my two kittens to this place because they lost appetite but they weren't that bad, babies kept playing with each other all the time, that rude old man in there …

The best! Very patient and attentive!
Highly recommended.

Very Nice people and professional.
Super recommend.💯 …
